races.name: Betting.Bet Free Racing Tips 'Hands And Heels' Handicap Hurdle (Conditional/Amateurs)
races.verdict:
INCA looks capable of following up his easy Huntingdon win. The dangers are headed by in-form Prairie Diamond, who'll handle any conditions, while God of Fire and Lunar Orbit also merit consideration.

  1. INCA (FR)
  2. PRAIRIE DIAMOND (IRE)
  3. GOD OF FIRE (IRE)

races.name: Betting.Bet New Betting Sites Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KAMILLE AU KANADA is fancied to resume winning ways with a comeback run under her belt. Interesting hurdling debutant Jetzet is feared most, with John Galt the pick of the remainder.

  1. KAMILLE AU KANADA (FR)
  2. JETZET (IRE)
  3. JOHN GALT (FR)

races.name: Betting.Bet Play Champion Tipster Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
CHARLES DARNAY could prove a class above his rivals on hurdling debut. Jerseygeordie looks the pick of those with experience, ahead of Houndswood Willow.

  1. CHARLES DARNAY
  2. JERSEYGEORDIE
  3. HOUNDSWOOD WILLOW (IRE)

races.name: Betting.Bet Play Champion Tipster Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Well-related OUR WEE HORSE made a bright start over hurdles and may be able to make his experience count. Hurdling debutant Poetry of Time is likely to be a serious threat if running to something like his Flat form. Meritocratic appeals most of the rest.

  1. OUR WEE HORSE (IRE)
  2. POETRY OF TIME
  3. MERITOCRATIC (IRE)

races.name: Betting.Bet Free Bets Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A tough call to split in-form pair LUCY THE WIRE and Getarose, with James Owen's charge narrowly preferred following her breakthrough success on the Flat last time.

  1. LUCY THE WIRE (IRE)
  2. GETAROSE (IRE)
  3. HELLO SWEETY

races.name: tigerbet.co.uk Download Our App Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This is a good opportunity for MISS KINGSTON to double her tally for a yard among the winners. Graceful Glance is readily preferred as the main danger, with Saxons Pride completing the shortlist.

  1. MISS KINGSTON (IRE)
  2. GRACEFUL GLANCE
  3. SAXONS PRIDE

races.name: Halo Leisure More Than Just A Gym Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SANDSCAPE and Malinas Glory stand out here. The former gets the vote having run well off a higher mark on reappearance last season, with relatively unexposed Bits Ballou also respected.

  1. SANDSCAPE
  2. MALINAS GLORY (IRE)
  3. BITS BALLOU

races.name: Free Race Replays On atttheraces.com Handicap Hurdle
All-Weather Championship Is Back Apprentice Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
A tricky race to open the card but STASH THE CASH ended his time with Martin Dunne with a solid second over C&D in the spring and having joined a yard that have done well with new recruits this year, he could be the answer. Midnight Lir is a long time without a win but rates a likely player, with Timebar and Tomarlo next best.

  1. STASH THE CASH (IRE)
  2. MIDNIGHT LIR (IRE)
  3. TIMEBAR

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Apprentice Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
AURADUE caught the eye with how fluently she moved into contention before failing to see her race out over 7f here 11 days ago, leaving the impression she has more in the locker if it can be coaxed out of her and could be worth chancing returned to sprinting. Recent course winner Pivotal Terms and Bridget's Baby are others to consider, along with the returning Kipp Kelly.

  1. AURADUE
  2. PIVOTAL TERMS
  3. BRIDGET'S BABY

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Bumper winner PEACE BELLE has to concede weight all round but she's already reached a useful level in defeat at listed level and looks to hold sound claims back in calmer waters. Yamnah appeals as the type to go on improving as she gains experience for John & Thady Gosden and can provide chief resistance.

  1. PEACE BELLE
  2. YAMNAH (FR)
  3. CRACKING BEAUTY

races.name: Midnite Ain't Your Grandads Bookie Handicap
races.verdict:
STERLING FORTUNE showed much-improved form when bolting up in first-time cheekpieces over C&D last week and whilst this rates more demanding, she ought to take some stopping if replicating that performance under a penalty. Toastmaster can bounce back from a lesser effort at Yarmouth and is feared, as are handicap debutants Yimmna and Mr Keble.

  1. STERLING FORTUNE
  2. TOASTMASTER (IRE)
  3. YIMMNA (FR)

races.name: Midnite Are Upping The Betting Game Handicap
races.verdict:
SONBELIEVABLE was an improved third at C&D on handicap debut last time and he makes appeal from an unchanged mark. Able Astra is next on the shortlist, with the returning Demetris Mouflon also holding claims.

  1. SONBELIEVABLE
  2. ABLE ASTRA (IRE)
  3. DEMETRIS MOUFLON

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BIG MONEY missed almost a year after his debut but showed improved form when runner-up here earlier in the month. Darkwing has been off the track for a year but remains open to improvement after a stable switch, whilst George Scott's Night of Thunder gelding Valor's Call merits respect on debut.

  1. BIG MONEY
  2. DARKWING
  3. VALOR'S CALL

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
Successful in a Kempton novice over this trip on her penultimate start, ENCORE found further improvement when second on handicap debut over 7f here 9 days ago, her not settling early probably costing her in the closing stages. A well-bred filly from a top yard, she remains open to improvement and shades preference over fellow 3-y-o and hat-trick seeking Courageous Sioux. Fantasy Obsessor and Angel Love complete the dangers.

  1. ENCORE (FR)
  2. COURAGEOUS SIOUX
  3. FANTASY OBSESSOR

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict:
KINNALARGY is worth a chance to build on quite a promising first run for the David O'Meara yard at Newcastle a fortnight ago. Riley Rocks went up 10 lb for his latest C&D success but should still be capable of a bold bid at a venue which suits. Overbudget is another who very much knows where the winning post is at this venue.

  1. KINNALARGY
  2. RILEY ROCKS
  3. OVERBUDGET (IRE)

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A tactical race looks in store but CHARGING THUNDER stopped the slide last time and can open his account for the year on the level from an attractive mark. The consistent Tarbat Ness can go well again, while Benvoy has returned to this sphere in good heart.

  1. CHARGING THUNDER
  2. TARBAT NESS
  3. BENVOY (IRE)

races.name: racingtv.com/freetrial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PROCYON shaped well under a considerate ride when a debut third at Newmarket and can take a fair step forward to thwart Olympiacos who rates the pick of these on form. Arctic Force, Sayaarr and Raguel appeal as the pick of the rest for minor honours.

  1. PROCYON (IRE)
  2. OLYMPIACOS (FR)
  3. ARCTIC FORCE (IRE)

races.name: EBF 'Double Trigger' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
IRON STONE LAD has shaped with promise when runner-up on both his starts at Newbury and York and can get off the mark here at the chief expense of Caldo who also looks to have better days ahead of him and rates a big threat. Charmed Boy is another open to progress and appeals as the pick of the remainder.

  1. IRON STONE LAD
  2. CALDO
  3. CHARMED BOY (IRE)

races.name: Market Cross Jewellers Handicap
races.verdict:
This is wide open and it could pay to side with TEN SIXTY SIX to gain a first success now she reverts to her optimum distance for her in-form yard. Stephen Hanlon's new recruit Take The A Train could also have a big say if ready to roll after 6 months off, while Kartini is another to consider at these weights if shrugging off a lesser effort over C&D.

  1. TEN SIXTY SIX (IRE)
  2. TAKE THE A TRAIN
  3. KARTINI (IRE)

races.name: Wear Your Poppy With Pride Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
NASCONDINO still looked a work in progress when runner-up in a Nottingham maiden last time and can go one better here now stepping up in trip. Merci Monsieur has a long absence to overcome but could still emerge as the main danger with his yard in top form, while Wadacre Icon and The Resdev Tyke also need factoring in.

  1. NASCONDINO (IRE)
  2. MERCI MONSIEUR (GER)
  3. WADACRE ICON

races.name: Jumps Look Better On Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
Lots with chances but YAFAARR comes here in excellent nick so is fancied to bag a third course success of the season at the chief expense of Naepoint who has fallen in the weights and hinted at a revival with a fourth at Ayr last time. 2024 winner Thunder Roar is another to note.

  1. YAFAARR (IRE)
  2. NAEPOINT (IRE)
  3. THUNDER ROAR

races.name: Bowel Cancer Screening Programme Saves Lives Selling Handicap
races.verdict:
Only a handful make any interest on recent form, with PHOENIX OF DREAMS taken to follow up from last time. Rascal Recknell should appreciate the return to this trip and is on a handy mark, while Kiss Me My Love arrives on the back of a couple of good efforts.

  1. PHOENIX OF DREAMS (IRE)
  2. RASCAL RECKNELL (FR)
  3. KISS ME MY LOVE (IRE)

races.name: Thanks And See You Next Season Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
BIG APPLE JACK has largely had a good season on the whole and can resume winning ways back down in trip. Course specialist Hurstwood should be thereabouts again, with Miss Rainbow another to consider.

  1. BIG APPLE JACK
  2. HURSTWOOD
  3. MISS RAINBOW (IRE)

races.name: Thanks And See You Next Season Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for a few but BEAUTY CHOICE has had excuses this season and is taken to capitalise on the drop into this grade. Showtime Mahomes has been in good form and can chase the selection home, with Wise Crack and Valentine Catcher also worth a check in the market.

  1. BEAUTY CHOICE
  2. SHOWTIME MAHOMES
  3. WISE CRACK (IRE)

races.name: Thanks And See You Next Season Handicap
British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The market should prove informative with the only runner with experience showing little so far, but MISS DEEDS is the obvious one on paper. Cala Vadella is second choice.

  1. MISS DEEDS
  2. CALA VADELLA
  3. BEAUTIFUL FORCE (IRE)

races.name: British EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ROGUE CONSTELATION showed plenty to work on when third behind the now useful winner at Ayr 5 weeks ago and is the one to beat. Oliver Cole has a decent bunch of 2-y-os this year so debutant Giant of Old could offer most resistance.

  1. ROGUE CONSTELATION (IRE)
  2. GIANT OF OLD (IRE)
  3. AL MHALHEL (IRE)

races.name: Christmas Parties At Leicester Racecourse - Book Now Nursery
races.verdict:
The vote goes to BLANQUITA, who clearly copes very well with these conditions and she was runner-up in a better race than this off this mark at Haydock recently. Blue Sign, Northern Exposure and Ground Force shaped well last time so are feared most, though all 3 have yet to race on testing ground.

  1. BLANQUITA
  2. BLUE SIGN
  3. NORTHERN EXPOSURE

races.name: Fireworks Festival Here Saturday 7th November Handicap
races.verdict:
A repeat of SUMMER EVENING's recent Ffos Las second might be enough to see her get off the mark in a thin race. Muhib can make the placings back at this more suitable trip, with Dinah Myte perhaps making most appeal of the remainder.

  1. SUMMER EVENING (IRE)
  2. MUHIB
  3. DINAH MYTE

races.name: Hamish's Birthday Countdown Handicap
races.verdict:
DANNICK arrives on the back of a pair of good second-placed finishes at Ascot and can go one place better with Toby Moore now taking the ride. Magic Box has made a good start over this trip and also makes appeal, with the in-form Between Me And U taken to complete the 1-2-3.

  1. DANNICK
  2. MAGIC BOX (IRE)
  3. BETWEEN ME AND U

races.name: Jumping's Back At Leicester Tuesday 17th November Handicap
races.verdict:
WODAO is evidently in his best form for some time and he looks up to completing a quick-fire hat-trick, still well treated on old form after all. Sole 3-y-o Woolisle should strip fitter for her comeback and is next best.

  1. WODAO (FR)
  2. WOOLISLE
  3. INGLEBY ARCHIE (IRE)

races.name: AJA Novice Flat Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
KOTARI can end his losing run dropped to a 0-60 for the first time. A Daughters Love can bounce back to form returned to a more suitable level if handling the conditions, with Glitter Code and Wrist Art also considered.

  1. KOTARI (FR)
  2. A DAUGHTERS LOVE
  3. GLITTER CODE (IRE)

races.name: Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DIVINE SYMMETRY made an encouraging start to his career at Newcastle and is preferred to Imperial Ballet, who is likely to be sharper with her recent Southwell comeback outing under her belt. Saeed bin Suroor newcomer Al Mandoos is one to check out in the betting.

  1. DIVINE SYMMETRY
  2. IMPERIAL BALLET
  3. AL MANDOOS

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Andrew Balding's Frankel colt IDEALISE makes plenty of appeal on pedigree and is taken to make a winning start. Stytch appeals ss a progressive type and could prove the chief threat ahead of Red Wizard and King Gamrah.

  1. IDEALISE
  2. STYTCH
  3. RED WIZARD

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
SHOWMASTER shaped with promise when third at Salisbury and this well-related son of Showcasing gets a confident vote to build on it and open his account. Richard Hannon's newcomer Easy Evening is bred to be above average and is next on the list, while Raslan and Punto Di Blu also need considering.

  1. SHOWMASTER
  2. EASY EVENING
  3. RASLAN

races.name: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap
races.verdict:
WEFFAAG has soft ground as a possible excuse on his York handicap debut and is given another chance as some of his earlier form suggests this mark should be workable. Fellow 3-y-os Siwa Oasis, a recent C&D winner, and Rogue Messiah head the many dangers along with Kempton specialist I'm Workin On It.

  1. WEFFAAG
  2. SIWA OASIS (IRE)
  3. ROGUE MESSIAH (IRE)

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
MALDIVES got her career back on track with her sights lowered when fourth in a handicap at Salisbury last time and can make it fifth time lucky. Liam Mera Kai, Sailor Song and Flagbearer are feared most in that order.

  1. MALDIVES (IRE)
  2. LIAM MERA KAI (FR)
  3. SAILOR SONG

races.name: Try Unibet's New Racing Bet Builder Handicap
races.verdict:
A really tight handicap. Low-mileage FIGHT YOUR CORNER took another step forward when narrowly denied over C&D last time and gets a narrow vote ahead of Get Outta Here, who has shaped on a few occasions like one who can definitely win more handicaps. Drifts Away and Gilet complete the shortlist.

  1. FIGHT YOUR CORNER (IRE)
  2. GET OUTTA HERE (FR)
  3. DRIFTS AWAY

races.name: Try Unibet's Superboosts Handicap
races.verdict:
A chance is taken on James Owen's new recruit BRAVE LEADER, with confidence in his chance increased should the betting vibes be strong. Ataturk doesn't have the easiest draw but he's made a positive start to his handicap career and is next on the list ahead of Kathleen Mary, who wasn't far behind Hughie Morrison's charge when the pair clashed at Leicester recently and Oisin Murphy takes the reins this time.

  1. BRAVE LEADER
  2. ATATURK
  3. KATHLEEN MARY

races.name: Unibet Supports Safer Gambling Handicap
races.verdict:
There was plenty to like about ROY LANE's latest C&D second on his first outing for James Fanshawe and he can go one better now. Fellow lightly-raced 3-y-o Preferred is second choice ahead of Everydaysasaturday, who made a positive start for the Tony Carroll stable when fourth at Brighton 3 weeks ago.

  1. ROY LANE
  2. PREFERRED
  3. EVERYDAYSASATURDAY (IRE)

races.name: Bet At racingtv.com Handicap
races.verdict:
Plenty with chances in this finale. ADA ROSE's latest Newcastle second looks reasonable form for the level and she's taken to land a second career success. State Express, Noble Grace and Oisin Murphy's mount Shopaholic are others to consider.

  1. ADA ROSE
  2. STATE EXPRESS (IRE)
  3. NOBLE GRACE (IRE)

races.name: Racing TV Free Trial For A Month Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
PALINCA ran out a 10-length winner on her only outing in points before fetching a cool £400,000 at the Cheltenham Festival Sale. She could be well placed to make a successful start under Rules for Henry de Bromhead. Dooks has more to offer over hurdles, while Brady Hartsfield is another to note on her first go in this sphere.

  1. PALINCA (FR)
  2. DOOKS (IRE)
  3. BRADY HARTSFIELD (IRE)

races.name: Botanica International Rated Novice Hurdle
races.verdict:
Unexposed HEY NOW may be able to follow up his much-improved Sligo success on return. Kentucky Beach is feared most if allowed the run of the race.

  1. HEY NOW
  2. KENTUCKY BEACH (FR)
  3. LE ROI DU LIVET (FR)

races.name: Start Your Free Trial On Racing TV Now Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Not a strong maiden on paper and WALKING SAINT could be the way to go as she retains potential on her return. Stablemate McAllister is a danger, while Caprison should have more to offer, and Eliodam may finally start fulfilling his potential for a new yard.

  1. WALKING SAINT
  2. MCALLISTER (IRE)
  3. CAPRISON (IRE)

races.name: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
THE COBBLERS WIFE can make it 2-2 over hurdles since joining Anthony Mullins. Talas Kera, Ardera Gun, Portetta and Champagne Dawn all look credible dangers in a competitive handicap, with Allroadsleadtorome a potential improver.

  1. THE COBBLERS WIFE (IRE)
  2. TALAS KERA (IRE)
  3. ARDERA GUN (IRE)

races.name: Michael Hickey Memorial Chase (Listed)
races.verdict:
Not an easy race to assess and it could pay to side with BOSSOFTHEBROWNIES who won on his seasonal return at Fairyhouse last season and can repeat the feat here. The Big Westerner also resumes after an absence but still warrants plenty of respect, while The Enabler also enters calculations on his reappearance.

  1. BOSSOFTHEBROWNIES (IRE)
  2. THE BIG WESTERNER (IRE)
  3. THE ENABLER (IRE)

races.name: racingtv.com/freetrial Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
ZANOOSH enjoyed a fine time of it over hurdles last season, gaining a fifth success in Grade 1 company at Fairyhouse in the spring, and she is fancied to make a winning start in this sphere. The Big Clubman also brings plenty of potential to chasing and could emerge as the main danger, while the lightly-raced Time Is A Thief is another who could have a say after a promising Killarney third on his fencing debut.

  1. ZANOOSH (IRE)
  2. THE BIG CLUBMAN (IRE)
  3. TIME IS A THIEF (IRE)

races.name: Thank You To All Our Sponsors & Supporters In 2026 (C & G) (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
HARTFORD will undoubtedly require further but he showed plenty in 2 notably warmer races last season and this looks a good opportunity for him to make a successful return. Tale of Intrigue might be the danger.

  1. HARTFORD (IRE)
  2. TALE OF INTRIGUE (IRE)
  3. SHINE ON SAM (IRE)

meeting_summary.going: Chase: soft to heavy; hurdle: soft

races.name: SANSERV Rated Novice Chase
races.verdict:
CORAL RIVER has taken well to chasing, winning a Clonmel novice in April, and is fancied to make a bold bid on return. Chasing newcomer King’s Bucks should do better in this sphere and is feared most in a trappy contest.

  1. CORAL RIVER (IRE)
  2. KING'S BUCKS (FR)
  3. ON YOUR WAY (IRE)

races.name: QuinnBet 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
SHARKEYBOY is a useful Flat performer and should take plenty of beating now switched to hurdling for powerful connections, with Green Soul feared most after a promising hurdles debut at Cork on the back of 13 months off. Fits Perfect is also respected.

  1. SHARKEYBOY (FR)
  2. GREEN SOUL (IRE)
  3. FITS PERFECT (IRE)

races.name: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction & Median Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
COOLISHAEL shaped as though he would have gone closer with an earlier challenge when runner-up at Listowel last time and is selected to go one better, with If You Believe feared most if fit enough to build on last season’s promising Rules efforts. Give It A Crack is also of interest.

  1. COOLISHAEL (IRE)
  2. IF YOU BELIEVE (IRE)
  3. GIVE IT A CRACK

races.name: Corrib Oil Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
BOYCETOWN acquitted himself really well in the Champion Bumpers at both Cheltenham and Punchestown and makes obvious appeal on his hurdles bow. Thinkitdontjinxit and This Songisforyou may provide the chief threat.

  1. BOYCETOWN (IRE)
  2. THINKITDONTJINXIT (IRE)
  3. THIS SONGISFORYOU (USA)

races.name: W.B. Gavin & Co. Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
TEED UP goes really well round here and is fancied to bounce back in style with victory at the chief expense of Shoot First, who returns on a handy-looking mark. Both Mystic Malina and Hgranca de Thaix can also play a prominent role.

  1. TEED UP (IRE)
  2. SHOOT FIRST (IRE)
  3. MYSTIC MALINA (IRE)

races.name: COLM QUINN BMW Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
VISION DE MAINE lost his form over fences for David Pipe last season but starts out for Emmet Mullins off a much reduced mark over hurdles so is worth siding with, especially if the market speaks in his favour. Laligurash is feared most on his first go over 3m, while last year's victor Grace Faraday and Lake Okeechobee also need factoring in.

  1. VISION DE MAINE (FR)
  2. LALIGURASH (IRE)
  3. GRACE FARADAY (IRE)

races.name: Electric Galway (C & G) (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
MARBLE HILL has joined Gavin Cromwell since his promising Bellewstown debut earlier this year and remains with potential. He gets the nod in the finale. Ballyadam Star looks the danger, although Here's Jim needs a look with Patrick Mullins up.

  1. MARBLE HILL (FR)
  2. BALLYADAM STAR (IRE)
  3. HERE'S JIM (IRE)

races.name: Prix De La Metropole Aix - Marseille - Provence Stakes
Criterium De Provence - Prix Lucien Planard Stakes
Prix De La Region Sud - Provence - Alpes-cote D'azur Maiden Stakes
Grand Prix Du Nord Listed Stakes
Prix De La Route Des Princes Handicap - AWT
Prix De La Route Des Blanchisseurs - AWT
Prix De La Route Belleval - AWT
Prix De La Croix Occitane Claiming Stakes
Prix Du Museum De Toulouse Claiming Stakes
Prix De La Cite De L'espace Handicap
Prix Du Musee De L'aeroscopia Handicap
Prix De La Cote Pavee Handicap
Prix Du Restaurant De L'hippodrome - Attele
Prix Du Golf Des Flandres - Attele
Prix De La Brasserie H De L'hippodrome - Attele
